page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8163 processor, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, and single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10 percent. However, the 32 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance, as evidenced by middle-tier results in stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression tests. Memory bandwidth tests for both cached and uncached reads also align with average industry standards, though the Passmark memory score is positioned in the lower 25 percent.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is structured for compute-bound tasks that benefit from parallel processing rather than high single-thread performance or massive memory footprints. It is suitable for multi-threaded workloads such as static web serving, compilation tasks, and moderate database operations, where it achieves average throughput. It can also handle basic LLM inference for small to medium models, though text generation speeds remain modest.
